literal_meaning: কটাক্ষ (তীক্ষ্ণ দৃষ্টি বা এক ঝলক দেখা) এ
figurative_meaning_en: in an instant; in a moment
similar_in_english: in the blink of an eye
example_sentences_in_english: He understood everything in an instant.
The work was finished in a moment.
note: This idiom draws from the literal sense of a quick glance to imply speed.
